about.en: Invesco QQQ (Ondo Tokenized) (QQQon) is an Ondo tokenized stock issued by Ondo Global Markets (BVI) Limited through the Ondo Stocks platform, giving eligible non-US holders economic exposure to the Invesco QQQ Trust ETF (QQQ). It is fully backed by the underlying security and is a total return tracker: dividends are reinvested net of withholding tax, so one token can come to represent more than one share and its price can drift above the underlying's. It is an ERC-20 on Ethereum at 0x0e397938c1aa0680954093495b70a9f5e2249aba, with deployments on BNB Chain and Solana. Holders have a claim on the issuer, not registered ownership or shareholder rights.
